Physical_Environment.Location: Tsinghua University, Beijing, China (assumed from ethics approval and university recruitment; software to be confirmed)

Experimental_Design.Conditions: 2 (experimental task: true self vs general self matching task; between-subjects) x 3 (identity: self, friend, stranger) x 2 (trial type: matching, nonmatching); mixed design, 60 trials per condition

Block_Structure.Trial_number: 360 trials total per participant (60 per condition; randomized order across 6 blocks)
Block_Structure.Practice_trials: practice block with feedback until 6 consecutive correct responses (variable length); practice data not included in the shared files

Trial_Structure.SOA: 0 ms (simultaneous presentation; shape above, label below, 3.5 deg apart)
Trial_Structure.Stimulus_order: Simultaneous: fixation cross, then shape (2.4 x 2.4 deg) above and label (approx. 4.4 x 2.4 deg) below
Trial_Structure.Response_deadline: 1100 ms (blank screen after stimulus during which response was made; 'Too Slow' feedback otherwise)
Trial_Structure.Feedback_duration: 500 ms (Correct / Incorrect / Too Slow after each trial)

Stimulus_Properties.Shape: geometric shapes: circle, square, triangle (2.4 x 2.4 deg); identity binding counterbalanced across participants and not recorded in the shared files
Stimulus_Properties.Label: identity words: self (true self task: true self; general self task: general self), friend, stranger (on-screen language/wording to be confirmed with authors)

exp3.detail: Experiment 3 of Zhao & Wang (2026, Psychon Bull Rev). Between-subjects manipulation of the self task: all participants first learned definitions of both true self and general self, then were randomly assigned to a true self matching task or a general self matching task (each paired with friend and stranger; 22 participants per group). Preregistered at AsPredicted (https://aspredicted.org/szh6-z3y7.pdf) prior to data collection. Response keys Z/M counterbalanced (not recorded; shared code response 1 = 'match' key, 0 = 'non-match' key). Data source: OSF https://osf.io/j2pxc/, file data/hddm_trial_data/exp3_hddm_trial_data.xlsx (task column: 1 = true self task, 2 = general self task) plus exp3_behavior_questionnaire.xlsx. All 44 recruited participants were analysed (19 female overall; true self task group: 22, 13 male/9 female, Mage 23.14; general self task group: 22, 12 male/10 female, Mage 22.64) and are present in the shared file. Shared trial file keeps only trials with a response and RT >= 200 ms (rows 15376 < 44 x 360 = 15840). Identity coding in the shared file: code 1 = the group's own self label (true self in task 1; general self in task 2), 2 = friend, 3 = stranger; recorded here accordingly, with the between-subjects task stored in the Group column. Label identity recorded only on matching trials; 'missing' elsewhere. Questionnaires after the task (online): BTS, SEB, SCS. Ethics: Tsinghua University Ethics Committee THU-04-2025-1135. On-screen stimulus language/wording and presentation software to be confirmed with the authors.
